input: Only reviewer-facing complete original sheet; no answer key, arm, grade or original evidence IDs used
query_rule: Two slots per blind card: subject rules/manual and visible model cooling guide (or subject installation guide if no model). No candidate numeric thresholds included. Model numbers permitted. Identical query keys share a cached result, charged to every requesting card.
selection: Local complete original first, then official public original. Screen first five official results in returned order. Prefer explicit model match over family; identifiable complete published version over extract; if version conflicts retain both within two-document/query cap. No ranking by numerical agreement. Exact model unknown is retained as gap.
stop: One local catalog/text pass per card; two public search slots, maximum five result links screened and two complete documents selected per query. Each selected document URL may be fetched once plus one official redirect/retry. Login/payment/denial stops that URL. Do not broaden searches based on apparent correctness. Shared complete documents may serve all cards, including limiting information.
access: No uploads, APIs, reviewer contact, login bypass or purchases. Restricted standards access recorded only. Local provenance unverified documents not presented as verified official downloads.
scope: Document existence/topic match is not project applicability or a truth label. Include unresolved model/configuration/version/acceptance criteria gaps. No support/opposition labels.
existing_edits: Desktop identity fields already edited; no scores in inspected cells. Preserve originals and record provision date. Do not require refilling or combine ratings under differing information conditions. External copies unknown.
connectivity_preflight: Two Scania connectivity searches occurred before protocol freeze; not used as evidence-based source selection. The frozen Scania slot is executed/cached under the same limits.
